ui.quit_confirm: Are you sure you want to forfeit the season?

match.dashboard_desc: This is where the match score is displayed. Right below, the counter shows how many plays (actions) remain until the end of the game.
match.field_desc: The field is divided into 5 zones. The ball ⚽ shows where the action is happening. Advance through the zones until you reach the opponent's goal!
match.possession_desc: This badge shows whether you're ATTACKING (the ball is yours, push forward!) or DEFENDING (the rival is pressuring, hold the line).
match.actions_desc: Each turn, you choose between 2 or 3 plays. Each one shows its success chance and what happens on success ❌ or failure ✅.
match.combo_badge_desc: Successful plays in a row increase your Combo. High Combo unlocks special plays and multiplies your coin reward at the end!
match.live_desc: The match is narrated in real time here. Follow the action so you don't miss a thing.
match.ready_desc: That's it! Pick the plays with the highest chance of success, build combos, and earn coins. Good luck, manager! 🏆

matchEnd: The referee blows the whistle! Game over!

tooltips.possessionAtk: The ball is ours! Advance through the field zones and choose the best play to create a scoring chance.
tooltips.possessionDef: Without the ball! Resist the rival's pressure and try to win possession back for a counterattack.
tooltips.combo: The team is on fire! Consecutive successes multiply your final cash reward and unlock special plays (e.g. Bicycle Kick).
tooltips.tactical: The team talk worked! Your squad gains a temporary Strength bonus for the next play.
tooltips.momentum: The flow of the match. Successful plays boost team confidence (Strength bonus), while mistakes create pressure (penalty).

howToPlay.title: HOW TO PLAY
howToPlay.intro:
Welcome to TurboFoot! You're the manager of a rising club. Your journey is to guide your team through the league map, defeat opponents, earn coins, and sign new players in the transfer market to challenge the season's biggest champions!

On the pitch, every match is decided play by play. Your success chances depend on your team's strength and chemistry compared to the rival. Choosing the right action at the right moment is the key to reaching the goal.
howToPlay.traitsIntro: Each Trait pushes your team toward a different playstyle! Stacking the SAME trait repeatedly gives diminishing returns — the secret is building a squad with 2 or 3 complementary specialties, not an entire team of clones. Watch out for trade-offs: every strength comes with a weakness.

traits.name: 🎯 Finishing
traits.desc: Natural goal scorers! HIGH bonus when Shooting on Goal. Provides no benefit outside the penalty area.

traits.name: 👟 Passing
traits.desc: Midfield maestros! Bonus on Low/Medium Risk plays (build-up and passing). No effect on High Risk plays.

traits.name: ⚡ Pace
traits.desc: Counterattack fuel! Bonus on ANY High Risk play, whether attacking or defending. No benefit on safe plays.

traits.name: 🪓 Tackling
traits.desc: Ball-winning specialists! Bonus on marking and tackles. Doesn't help goalkeepers make saves.

traits.name: 🧤 Reflexes
traits.desc: A wall between the posts! Huge bonus on goalkeeper saves. Only works inside your own penalty area.

traits.name: 🛡️ Positioning
traits.desc: Tactical awareness! Reduces the rival's strength on all their plays. A weaker but always useful effect.

traits.name: 🔗 Vision
traits.desc: The team thinks as one! Successful passing or dribbling plays generate extra Combo, but works best with varied team traits.

traits.name: 🗣️ Leadership
traits.desc: A true captain! Reduces the damage from failed plays and strengthens the player wearing the armband. Does not increase success chance.
